name: of1-recommendation-editors-choice
description: An editorial editors'-choice layout: one highlighted pick with a pull-quote and rationale, an 'also great for' row of situational picks, and a closing editors' note.

slots.instruction: Short editorial kicker such as 'Editors' Choice' above the headline.
Personalized headline framing this as the editors' pick for the visitor's situation.
One-sentence editorial summary of how the pick was chosen and what else stood out.
Primary hero call to action jumping to the editors' pick.
Product image for the editors' choice pick. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Badge label overlaid on the image flagging the editors' choice.
Name of the editors' choice product.
Monthly price of the editors' choice product.
Short pricing reassurance such as contract or price-guarantee terms.
Editorial pull-quote capturing why this pick wins, written in a confident review voice.
Attribution line naming the reviewing team behind the pick.
Paragraph explaining in detail why the editors chose this product for the visitor.
Bulleted list of the standout features that earned this pick the top spot.
Call to action to select the editors' choice product.
Heading introducing the situational 'also great for' alternatives, e.g. 'Also great for...'.
Product image for the first situational pick, matching its product. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Short situational label for the first pick, e.g. 'For a smaller place'.
Name of the first situational pick.
Monthly price of the first situational pick.
Short description of the first situational pick and who it suits.
Link to view or select the first situational pick.
Product image for the second situational pick, matching its product. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Short situational label for the second pick, e.g. 'For a busy household'.
Name of the second situational pick.
Monthly price of the second situational pick.
Short description of the second situational pick and who it suits.
Link to view or select the second situational pick.
Product image for the third situational pick, matching its product. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Short situational label for the third pick, e.g. 'For cutting the bill'.
Name of the third situational pick.
Monthly price of the third situational pick.
Short description of the third situational pick and who it suits.
Link to view or select the third situational pick.
Short kicker above the editors' closing note, e.g. 'The editors' bottom line'.
Heading for the editors' closing recommendation note.
Editorial closing note advising how the visitor should combine the picks.
Closing call-to-action heading.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to start the order.
